description: This is a PHP script for the installer CLI of the OrangeHRM system. It handles the setup process, including configuration, database creation, migrations, and administrative user setup. It also outputs instructions for deprecated usage.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Handles user session management, starting and maintaining sessions during installation.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents HTTP request data, specifically used here for the POST method during installer API handling.

classes.name: UserCredential
classes.description: Encapsulates database user credentials (username and password).

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Provides configuration-related methods, such as checking if the system is already installed.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: Manages service dependencies, including session storage.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Defines constants for service keys used in dependency injection.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Initializes the HTTP framework kernel for the installer.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Provides methods for creating databases, running migrations, and configuring system settings during installation.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: Stores temporary state data during the installation process, such as database info and admin user data.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: Handles API requests for installer data registration, invoked at the end of the script.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates the database as part of installation.

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts initial system configuration into the database.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates a database user for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Writes configuration files required for the system.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Writes encryption key files if data encryption is enabled.
